hyperbaric._note: RWR Runner program (Shaper). Code gate icebreaker. Install: place 1 power counter. +1 strength per hosted counter. 1cr: break 1 code gate subroutine. 2cr: place 1 power counter.

trickster_taka._note: RWR Runner resource (Criminal, Companion). Turn start + steal agenda: place 1 hosted credit. Spend hosted credits on programs during runs. Turn end: if 3+ hosted credits, must take 1 tag or trash self.

wake_implant_v2a_jrj._note: RWR Runner hardware (Shaper). Install: suffer 1 meat damage. Successful HQ run: place 1 power counter. Breach R&D: may remove up to 3 hosted counters to access that many additional cards.

keiko._note: RWR Runner resource (Shaper, Console). +2 MU. First time each turn you install a companion card or spend credits from a companion card: gain 1cr. Limit 1 console per player.

the_wizards_chest._note: RWR Runner hardware (Shaper). Use only if made successful runs on HQ, R&D, and Archives this turn. Trash: choose type (hardware/program/resource), reveal top of stack until 2 of that type found, install 1 ignoring costs, shuffle rest back.

eru_ayase_pessoa._note: RWR Runner resource (Shaper). Once per turn — click + take 1 tag: run Archives; if successful, breach R&D instead. Threat 3: whenever you breach R&D during an Archives run, access 1 additional card. Full redirect requires engine support; threat bonus is passive.

pinhole_threading._note: RWR Runner event (Anarch). Run any server. If successful, instead of breaching the attacked server, access 1 card in the root of another server. Agendas accessed this way cannot be stolen or trashed.

sisyphus_protocol._note: RWR Corp agenda 3/2 (Jinteki, Security). Ongoing while scored: the first time each turn the Runner passes a rezzed code gate or sentry, Corp may pay 1cr or trash 1 HQ card to force the Runner to encounter that ice again. Listener registered at install; self_in_corp_score_area guards pre-scoring; once_per_turn_key limits to first pass each turn.

azef_protocol._note: RWR Corp agenda 3/2 (HB). Additional cost to score: trash 1 of your other installed cards (engine support needed). On score: do 2 meat damage.

remastered_edition._note: RWR Corp agenda 4/2 (HB). On score: place 1 agenda counter on this card. Click + hosted agenda counter: place 1 advancement counter on an installed card.

sds_drone_deployment._note: RWR Corp agenda 3/2 (Weyland). Additional cost to steal: trash 1 installed program. On score: trash 1 installed program.

cohort_guidance_program._note: RWR Corp asset 2-trash (HB). Corp turn start: may choose — (A) trash 1 HQ card to gain 2cr and draw 1; or (B) flip 1 facedown Archives card faceup to place 1 advancement counter on an installed card.

modes.label: Trash 1 card from HQ: gain 2[credit] and draw 1 card
Flip 1 facedown Archives card faceup: place 1 advancement counter on an installed card

drago_ivanov._note: RWR Corp asset (NBN). Advanceable. 2 hosted advancement counters (Corp turn only): give the Runner 1 tag.

tatu_bola._note: TAI Corp ice (Jinteki). AI Sentry. Str 4. on_runner_passes: Corp may swap with ice from HQ, gain 4cr. Sub: end the run.

tributary._note: RWR Corp ice (Weyland). Barrier. Str 4. Run start (first time per turn, on this server): Corp may move this ice to the outermost position. Sub 1: draw 1 (optional); install 1 ice from HQ on another server (optional, free). Sub 2: each ice +2 strength for this run.

subroutines.label: You may draw 1 card. You may install 1 piece of ice from HQ protecting another server, ignoring all costs.
Each piece of ice gets +2 strength for the remainder of this run.

lycian_multi_munition._note: RWR Corp ice (Weyland). Barrier/Code Gate/Sentry (chosen on rez). Str 3. On rez: Corp chooses 1+ subtypes among barrier, code gate, sentry; ice gains those subtypes. At end of any turn: derez. Sub 1 (code gate): Runner loses [click] and 1cr. Sub 2 (sentry): trash 1 installed program. Sub 3 (barrier): Corp gains 1cr; end the run.

subroutines.label: If this ice is a code gate, the Runner loses [click] and 1[credit].
If this ice is a sentry, trash 1 installed program.
If this ice is a barrier, gain 1[credit] and end the run.

drafter._note: RWR Corp ice (HB). Code gate. Str 2. Sub: add 1 card from Archives to HQ. Sub: install 1 card from Archives or HQ, ignoring all costs.

subroutines.label: You may add 1 card from Archives to HQ.
You may install 1 card from Archives or HQ, ignoring all costs.

tucana._note: RWR Corp upgrade (Weyland). Remote server only. Persistent: whenever an agenda is scored or stolen from the root of this server, may search R&D for 1 ice, install and rez it paying 3cr less.

the_holo_man._note: RWR Corp upgrade (HB). Corp turn start: may move self to root of another server. Once per turn — click + 4cr: place 2 advancement counters on 1 card in root of or protecting this server (3 counters if no HQ installs this turn).

kingmaking._note: RWR Corp agenda 3/2 (NBN). On score: draw up to 3 cards. May add 1 agenda worth 1 or fewer points from HQ to your score area without advancing it.

eminent_domain._note: RWR Corp agenda 3/1 (Weyland). Expendable from HQ: click + 1cr + trash → install and rez 1 HQ card paying 5cr less (expendable mechanic requires engine support). On score: search R&D for 1 card, install and rez it ignoring all costs.

expendable_action.label: [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash from HQ: Install and rez 1 card from HQ, paying 5[credit] less.

nuvem_sa_law_of_the_land._note: RWR Corp identity (Weyland). Whenever Corp finishes resolving an operation or an action on an expendable card: look at the top card of R&D, may trash it. First time Corp trashes a card from R&D each turn: gain 2cr.

thunderbolt_armaments_peace_through_powe._note: RWR Corp identity (HB). Whenever you rez a piece of AP or destroyer ice during a run: that ice gets +1 strength and gains '[sub] End the run unless the Runner trashes 1 installed card.' after its other subroutines for the remainder of that run.

params.label: End the run unless the Runner trashes 1 of their installed cards.

melies_u_only_the_brightest._note: VP36 Méliès U: Only the Brightest. Corp identity (Division). 3-sided flip. Card ID matches NRDB slug.

ashen_epilogue._note: RWR Neutral Runner event. Shuffle grip and heap into stack, RFG top 5, draw 5, RFG self.

capacitor._note: RWR NBN ice (Barrier). Str 2. While Runner is tagged, +2 strength. Sub 1: Corp gains 1cr per Runner tag. Sub 2: End the run.

subroutines.label: Gain 1[credit] for each tag the Runner has.

coalescence._note: RWR Shaper program. 1 MU, cost 2. On install: 2 power counters. [click], hosted power counter: gain 2cr (own turn only — modelled as runner_turn_start optional spend).

corporate_hospitality._note: RWR HB operation (Double, Transaction). Additional cost: [click]. Gain 6cr, draw 2, add 1 Archives card to HQ.

friend_of_a_friend._note: RWR Anarch resource (Connection). Two click+trash paid abilities: (A) gain 5cr + remove 1 tag; (B) gain 9cr + take 1 tag (only if untagged). Modelled as runner_turn_start optional click+trash.

choices.label: [click], trash: Gain 9[credit] and take 1 tag (only if not tagged)

pretty_mary_da_silva._note: RWR Shaper resource (Connection, Seedy). Whenever you breach R&D, if allowed to access 2+ cards, access 1 additional card.

sorocaban_blade._note: RWR HB ice (Destroyer, Sentry). Cannot trash more than 1 installed Runner card per encounter. Sub 1: trash 1 resource. Sub 2: trash 1 hardware. Sub 3: trash 1 program.

stoke_the_embers._note: RWR NBN agenda 3/2 (Initiative). On score: gain 3cr + place 1 advancement on installed card. Install-from-non-HQ trigger not implemented (requires install-source tracking).

valentina_ferreira_carvalho._note: RWR Neutral Runner resource (Connection). Whenever you remove 1+ tags, gain 1cr. Threat 3 install bonus: remove 1 tag or gain 2cr.

modes.label: Remove 1 tag
Gain 2[credit]

charlotte_cacador._note: RWR HB asset. Advanceable (card text says 'can be advanced'). Corp turn start: if 1+ advancement counter on this, may remove 1 → gain 4cr, draw 1.

warm_reception._note: RWR Corp asset. Corp turn start: install 1 card from HQ (optional). If no ice is protecting this asset's server, also derez self and 1 other rezzed card.

janaina_jk_dumont_kindelan._note: RWR Corp asset. Turn start: place 3cr on this card. [click]: take all hosted credits + may install 1 card from HQ.

the_powers_that_be._note: RWR NBN agenda 4/2. On score: Corp may install 1 card from HQ or Archives, ignoring all costs.

hearts_and_minds._note: RWR Weyland upgrade. Corp turn start: move 1 advancement token from one installed card to another. If the destination has no ice protecting its server, also place 1 new advancement counter on it.

working_prototype._note: RWR Neutral Runner resource. Whenever Corp rezzes any card: add 1 power counter. [click], 1 counter: gain 3cr. [click], 5 counters: gain 6cr + move 1 resource from heap to top of stack.

modes.label: [click], 1 power counter: Gain 3[credit]
[click], 5 power counters: Gain 6[credit] and add 1 resource from heap to top of stack

meeting_of_minds._note: RWR Shaper event. Search stack for 1 connection or virtual card; reveal it; gain 1cr for each copy of that card's subtypes already in grip. Shuffle stack.

pressure_spike._note: RWR Anarch fracter program. Threat 4 paid ability: spend 2cr to gain +9 strength for the remainder of this run (once per run).

modes.label: Threat 4 — 2[credit]: +9 strength for this run

malandragem._note: RWR Anarch program. Encounter ability (once/turn): spend 1 power counter → bypass ice if str ≤ 3. Threat 4: remove from game → bypass any ice.

modes.label: 1 power counter: Bypass this ice if its strength is 3 or less (once per turn)
Threat 4: Remove from game — bypass any ice

physarum_entangler._note: RWR Anarch trojan. install_on_ice: true. Encounter ability: pay 1cr per unbroken sub → bypass host ice (non-barrier only). trashed_on_purge: true.

modes.label: Pay 1[credit] per unbroken subroutine: Bypass this ice (non-barrier only)

arruaceiras_crew._note: RWR Anarch resource. Encounter ability (once/turn): take 1 tag → ice gets -2 str. [click]+2cr+trash: trash encountered ice if its strength is 0 or less.

modes.label: Take 1 tag: Encountered ice gets -2 strength (once per turn)
[click], 2[credit], trash self: Trash the encountered ice (only if strength ≤ 0)

isaac_liberdade._note: RWR Shaper trojan program. install_on_ice: true. Passive: if host ice has advancement tokens, +2 str to host ice during encounter. On host ice rez: +1 power counter. Runner turn end: may spend [click] to move to a different installed ice.

airbladex_jsrf_ed._note: AI hardware. 3 power counters on install; trashed when empty. Two [interrupt] abilities paid with power counters: (1) prevent 1 net damage during a run; (2) prevent a 'when encountered' ice ability. Both are handled in GameContext.spend_airbladex_counter() and the call sites in AbilityInterpreter._deal_damage() and RunStateMachine._fire_ice_when_encountered(). The on_rez trigger places the 3 initial counters.

amanuensis._note: RWR Shaper console. is_console: true. Runner turn end while tagged: +1 power counter. tag_removed: per tag removed, spend 1 power counter → draw 2 cards.

alarm_clock._note: RWR Criminal event. Each runner turn start: optional run on HQ. During approach of first ice, may spend 2 [click] to bypass it.

cataloguer._note: RWR Shaper program. On rez: 2 power counters. Successful run on R&D: spend 1 counter to reorder top 4 cards. Click ability: spend 1 counter to breach R&D skipping ice.

juli_moreira_lee._note: RWR Criminal resource. 4 power counters. First time each turn a rig card ability is used: spend 1 counter → gain 1 [click].

trick_shot._note: RWR Criminal event. Gain 4 run credits. Run R&D. If successful: gain 2cr + 1 bonus access. After run: may immediately run a remote.

burner._note: RWR Criminal event. Run HQ. If successful: reveal 3 random HQ cards; runner places 2 on top or bottom of R&D.

window_of_opportunity._note: RWR Criminal event. Optional: install 1 program or hardware from grip. Derez 1 ice at start of run. Corp may rez that ice for free at run end. Make a run.

spree._note: RWR Criminal event. 3 counters. Make a run. During encounter windows, spend 1 counter to move an installed trojan to ice on the run server.

eye_for_an_eye._note: RWR Criminal event. Condition: runner is untagged. Run HQ. On success: take 1 tag + 1 bonus access. During access: may trash 1 grip card to trash the accessed corp card.

privileged_access._note: RWR Criminal event. Condition: runner is untagged. Run Archives. May take 1 tag to install from heap for 2cr less instead of breaching. Threat 3: may also install 1 program.

manuel_lattes_de_moura._note: RWR Criminal resource. (a) While tagged: +1 access per breach of HQ/R&D. (b) Threat 3 trash interrupt: Corp must trash 1 HQ card first or the trash fails.

amelia_earhart._note: RWR Criminal resource. Tracks HQ/R&D accesses via ctx.amelia_hq_rd_access_count (incremented in RunStateMachine). Turn start: if 3+ tracked, spend 3 clicks + trash self → Corp loses 10cr.

cupellation._note: RWR Runner Program. Access → 1cr: host the accessed non-agenda Corp card faceup on this program. Whenever you breach HQ, if this program has a hosted Corp card, you may pay 1cr and trash this program to access 2 additional cards.

brasilia_government_grid._note: RWR Corp Upgrade (Grid/Region). Once per turn: when Corp rezzes a piece of ice during a run against this server, may derez another installed ice; if so, the newly rezzed ice gets +3 strength for the remainder of that run.

sebastiao_souza_pessoa_activist_organize._note: RWR Runner Resource Connection. When runner takes 1+ tags from 0: may install 1 connection from grip paying 2cr less. As additional cost for Corp to basic-trash any connection: Corp must trash 1 card from HQ.

lightning_laboratory._note: RWR Corp Agenda 5/3. On score: place 1 agenda counter. Whenever a run begins, may spend 1 agenda counter to rez up to 2 ice protecting the attacked server ignoring all costs. At runner_turn_end, derez 2 ice protecting that server.

logjam._note: RWR Corp ICE. You can advance this ice. +1 str per hosted advancement counter. On rez: place 1 + distinct card types (faceup Archives) counters. Subs: Gain 2cr+ETR / ETR / ETR.

hammer._note: RWR Corp ICE Sentry. Break limit: runner may break only 1 printed sub per encounter except using killers. Subs: Give 1 tag / Trash 1 resource or hardware / Trash 1 program that is not decoder/fracter/killer.

subroutines.label: Trash 1 installed resource or piece of hardware.
Trash 1 installed program that is not a decoder, fracter, or killer.

boto._note: RWR Corp ICE. Threat 4: +2 str. Subs: Do 2 net damage / may trash 1 HQ card→ETR / may trash 1 HQ card→ETR.

subroutines.label: You may trash 1 card from HQ to end the run.
You may trash 1 card from HQ to end the run.

business_as_usual._note: RWR Corp Operation. Resolve 1 of: advance up to 2 installed advanceable cards / remove all virus counters from 1 card. Threat 3: also resolve the other mode.

modes.label: Place 1 advancement counter on each of up to 2 installed cards you can advance.
Remove all virus counters from 1 installed card.

seraph._note: RWR Corp ICE Sentry. On encounter: Runner loses 3cr unless they suffer 2 net damage or take 1 tag. Subs: Lose 3cr / Do 2 net damage / Give 1 tag.

cloud_eater._note: RWR Corp ICE Sentry. Whenever encounter ends, if rezzed this turn: trash 1 installed Runner card unless Runner takes 2 tags or suffers 3 net damage. Subs: Trash 1 installed Runner card / Give Runner 2 tags / Do 3 net damage.

descent._note: RWR Corp ICE. Activate from HQ: [click]+1cr+reveal+trash from HQ: draw 1 card, reveal up to 2 agendas from HQ/Archives and shuffle into R&D. Corp turn start: may add this ice to HQ. Sub: End the run.

boi_tata._note: RWR Runner Program Icebreaker Sentry 4/2. If you trashed any of your installed cards this turn, paid abilities on this program cost 1cr less. Interface → 2cr: Break up to 2 sentry subroutines. 3cr: +3 strength.

piranhas._note: RWR Corp ICE 4/2. Additional rez cost: take 1 bad pub OR remove 1 tag. Subs: Corp may draw 1 / Do 1 net damage / ETR if HQ cards > runner grip cards.

subroutines.label: End the run if there are more cards in HQ than in the grip.

the_basalt_spire._note: RWR Corp Agenda 5/3. On steal: Corp may add 1 card from Archives to HQ. On score: place 2 agenda counters. Once per turn click action: spend 1 agenda counter + trash top R&D → add 1 card from Archives to HQ.

oracle_thinktank._note: TAI Corp agenda 2/1 (NBN). When stolen: give Runner 1 tag. Corp click action while in Runner's score area: [click] + remove 1 Runner tag → shuffle back into R&D.

epiphany_analytica_nations_undivided._note: TAI Corp identity (NBN). The first time each turn the Runner steals or trashes a Corp card, place 1 power counter on this identity. [click], hosted power counter: look at top 3 R&D; may install 1.

a_teia_ip_recovery._note: TAI Corp identity (Jinteki). Limit 2 remote servers. The first time each turn the Corp installs in the root of or protecting a remote server, may install 1 card from HQ in another remote for free (cannot score that card this turn). Enforced in TurnManager: can_create_new_remote_server(), _a_teia_free_install(), _score_agenda().

adrian_seis._note: TAI Corp upgrade (Jinteki, Psi - Clone - Sysop, trash 2). Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on this server, play a psi game. Bids differ (Corp wins): runner cannot access cards other than Adrian Seis this run. Bids match (runner wins): runner cannot access Adrian Seis this run. Corp turn end: may move this upgrade to another server root.

chrysopoeian_skimming._note: TAI Corp asset (Weyland). Paid ability: 1cr, trash — Corp gains [click]. Implemented as a click_action in digital edition (one activation per turn).

slash_and_burn_agriculture._note: TAI Corp operation (Weyland). Reveal and trash 1 card from HQ as a cost; place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card.

tree_line._note: TAI Corp operation (Weyland). Reveal and trash 1 card from HQ as a cost; place 3 advancement counters on 1 installed card.

greasing_the_palm._note: TAI Corp operation (Weyland). Place 1 advancement counter on each of up to 3 different installed cards.

bahia_bands._note: TAI Runner event (Criminal, 2cr). Run any server. If successful, resolve 2 of the following in any order: draw 2 cards; install 1 card from grip at 1cr discount; remove 1 tag; place 4cr on this event for trash costs.

options.label: Place 4cr on event (spend for trash costs)
